name: Waydroid Native Android Subsystem
author: Project Tuki / Purr Ecosystem
description: Turnkey native Android application runtime on Arch Linux & KDE Plasma 6 with auto ARM translation (libndk), multi-window freeform mode, KWin window rules, PipeWire audio, folder sharing, and Purr APK CLI integration.
highlights: Acrylic multi-window decor overlay and white titlebar icons
Headless 32-bit app repair with zero chat loss
Dynamic display geometry and HiDPI coordinate normalization
